rooms.923: A worn stair of rough stone cuts down out of the pit toward the river-smelling air of the beach, its steps hollowed by years of hooves. Heat gathers in the sunken bowl and hangs there, thick with dust and the rank smell of beast. The pit wall rises sheer on every hand, scored with long scratches at the height of a horn. The floor of packed sand runs on east into the arena.
rooms.926: Pale sand drifts over the floor here, and everywhere in it lie bones: ribs, jawbones and the long shins of cattle and worse, trampled half to powder. The curving wall of the pit is stained brown to well above your head. A dry, coppery stink rises from the sand whenever your boots stir it. The passage runs on east and back west toward the stair.
rooms.928: A great timber rack leans against the stone here, bristling with notched swords, bent spears and axes with splintered hafts. Many of the weapons are far too large for any man to swing, and all of them are streaked with rust or something darker. Shards of broken blades crunch in the dust underfoot. The passage continues east, and the way west leads back toward the stair.
rooms.929: In this cramped corner of the pit someone has made a kind of camp, with a stone ledge scraped smooth and a sleeping hollow scratched deep into the packed earth beneath it. A faded battle-standard hangs from a spike driven into the wall, stiff with dust and cut to ribbons at its edge. Tiny claw marks furrow the floor around the hollow in neat, soldierly rows. Passages lead off east and west from this corner.
rooms.930: The air here is sour with old sweat, and a pair of enormous stone weights lie on the sand beside an iron bar bent into a shallow bow. Grapefruit rinds, dried hard and brown, are scattered across the floor, and a few are heaped against the wall as though someone eats here between bouts of heavy lifting. Scuffed rings in the dust mark where wrestlers have circled one another. The passage leads east and west.
rooms.931: The ceiling drops low here, and the walls close in until a broad-shouldered visitor must turn aside to pass. Torch brackets of black iron hold stubs of guttering tallow, and the smoke has painted the stone above them with greasy soot. Hoofprints as wide as dinner plates are baked into the hardened floor. The passage slips on east into deeper gloom, while west lies the way back toward the arena.
rooms.932: A deep, damp draught moves along this stretch of passage, and with it comes the steady rush of the river through the stone, somewhere close beyond the wall. Water seeps down the masonry in dark streaks and gathers in a shallow, muddy trough along the floor. Strings of old horn and knuckle-bone hang from a rafter, clicking softly against one another. The passage runs on east and west.
rooms.933: The passage ends in a wide, crumbling landing where the stone floor is cracked and strewn with chunks of fallen masonry. Painted on the wall in dull red, a huge bull's head glares out at those who come this far, its eyes mere black holes. Heat and a heavy animal reek pour down from the way north. The passage you came by runs back west.
rooms.934: Here, at the far end of the pit, a throne has been raised on a dais of rough slabs, built entirely of horns lashed and wedged together into a monstrous seat. Heaped skulls form a low rampart at its foot, and every surface is slick with grease and dust. A steep stair climbs up into the dark, toward a chamber of cold stone above. The only other way out is south, back down the passage.
rooms.922: You are in a low, lightless hollow beneath the pit, where the air is stale and dry and the floor is gritty underfoot. Rough stone presses close on every side, and a crooked shaft in the roof lets a thread of daylight and river air trickle down. Gold dust and tarnished flecks of metal glint faintly wherever your eyes can pick them out. A narrow climb leads up and out toward the beach.

934.description: The throne is a tangle of horns, hundreds of them, from goats and oxen and some far larger, bound with greasy cord and wedged tightly together. The seat is worn smooth and dark by long use.
